Job Responsibilities: Assist the Project Manager in planning and execution of NHAI highway projects . Monitor day-to-day construction activities and ensure work is completed as per approved drawings, specifications, and project schedule. Supervise construction works related to Highways, Roads, Bridges, Box Culverts, RCC Structures, Drainage, and other infrastructure works . Ensure execution of Bridges and Box Culverts as per approved drawings, technical specifications, and quality standards. Coordinate with NHAI officials, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, and site teams . Ensure construction activities comply with NHAI and MoRTH specifications and standards . Monitor project progress, productivity, quality, manpower, materials, and equipment. Coordinate with planning and execution teams to achieve project milestones within the scheduled time. Assist in quantity estimation, BOQ verification, measurements, and billing . Monitor concrete works, reinforcement, shuttering, earthwork, subgrade, GSB, WMM, DBM, BC, drainage, and structural works. Coordinate with QA/QC team for inspections, testing, and quality compliance. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports . Identify site issues and coordinate with concerned teams for timely resolution. Monitor subcontractor performance and ensure work is executed as per contractual requirements. Maintain proper records of drawings, measurements, inspection reports, site instructions, and project correspondence. Assist the Project Manager during NHAI/Authority inspections, site meetings, and progress review meetings . Ensure compliance with site safety procedures and quality requirements . Coordinate with survey, QA/QC, billing, planning, and execution teams . Support the Project Manager in achieving project targets for time, cost, quality, and safety . Qualification & Experience: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering . 58 years of experience in highway/infrastructure construction. Experience in NHAI/National Highway projects preferred. Experience in Bridges, Box Culverts, and Highway Construction is required/preferred. Good knowledge of MoRTH specifications, NHAI requirements, and construction practices . Good communication, coordination, documentation, and team-handling skills. Willingness to work at project sites.

Key Skills: Foundation,Flyovers,Road work,Pile foundation,Assistance,Retention,Bridges,Culverts
